title: Ligand Preparation [lig147, lig200]
body:
### 1. lig147 & lig200 plate preparation

*NOTE: All ligands for SELEX being prepared fresh at this point*

Dilute both oligos 1:200 ⇒ 2 uL oligo + 398 uL TE buffer (lig147-d200, lig200-d200)

PCR 1 → 100X
25 uL per well in two 96-well plates.

| Reagent | Volume (µL) |
| ----- | ----- |
| **Final diluted DNA** | **150** |
| **Phusion Master Mix** | **2500** |
| **NCAP\_F (10 µM)** | **250** |
| **NCAP\_R (10 uM)** | **250** |
| **Water** | **1850**  |
| **Total** | **5000** |

25 uL per well in two 96-well plates.

| 98°C | 3 min |
| :---- | :---- |

| 72°C | 30 s |
